title: The Daily Brief
greeting: Good morning. This is a sample edition; your own paper is designed from the wishes in your config.

items.title: Sample headline: the day's most important story appears here
items.summary: News is researched from the last day or two and summarised in two or three plain sentences, with its source named.

items.title: Sample headline: topics follow your wishes
items.summary: Mention what you follow, from local politics to astronomy, and the front page adapts.

items.title: Sample headline: fewer stories on slow days
items.summary: The writer is told never to invent news. When little is fresh, it prints fewer items rather than filler.

right.title: One thing to know
right.body: Honeybees communicate the direction and distance of flowers with a 'waggle dance': the angle of the dance relative to vertical matches the angle of the food source relative to the sun.
right.note: Sample: a daily explainer, because the wishes ask to learn one interesting thing a day.

right.title: On this day
items: Sample: notable events on today's date, one line each.
Sections like this appear when your wishes suggest them.

right.text: The beginning is the most important part of the work.
right.author: Plato

items.example: She gave a lucid explanation of a complicated idea.
items.tip: Use it: describe something you read today as lucid, or not.

items.example: Thanks for the candid feedback; it helped.
Keep the update succinct: three bullet points.

right.title: Thinking tool: the Feynman technique
right.body: To check whether you really understand something, explain it in simple words to someone with no background. Where you reach for jargon or get stuck, you've found a gap: go back, fill it, and simplify again.
right.note: Try it: explain one idea from the front page out loud in under a minute.

right.title: Write for five minutes
right.body: What is one thing you learned this week that changed how you see something?

learning.subject: English vocabulary
learning.note: Started with words for clear communication.
